title: Specification and Optimization of Code-Based Masking
summary: A generic code-based masking scheme is known, but its concrete specification and optimization remain open.

formal_statement.body: A generic code-based masking scheme has been proposed, but its further specification and optimization remain unresolved; the open task is to provide a concrete specification of the scheme and optimize it.

scope.domain: Side-channel masking in the design of cryptographic primitives.
parameters: Generic code-based masking scheme, the construction to be further specified and optimized
scope.unresolved_remainder: Provide a concrete specification of the generic code-based masking scheme and optimize it.

citations.label: Packed Multiplication: How to Amortize the Cost of Side-channel Masking?

progress.summary: The source presents code-based masking as a generic scheme and explicitly states that its further specification and optimization were left as an open problem.
citation_labels: Weijia Wang et al., Packed Multiplication: How to Amortize the Cost of Side-channel Masking?
